title: Seeds to GROW - Sitara Jabeen
overview: Born in a small and deeply conservative city in Pakistan, Sitara Jabeen is a rebel by nature. She has had to overcome personal, familial, societal, and cultural barriers to become what she always wanted to be: a fully independent woman. But for Sitara, that’s only the beginning — she now aims to transform the entire humanitarian system.
